spans.text: [6] AR: لَهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَمَا تَحْتَ ٱلثَّرَىٰ EN: To Him belongs what is in the heavens and what is on the earth and what is between them and what is under the soil.

spans.text: [7] AR: وَإِن تَجْهَرْ بِٱلْقَوْلِ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَعْلَمُ ٱلسِّرَّ وَأَخْفَى EN: And if you speak aloud - then indeed, He knows the secret and what is [even] more hidden.

entries.description: there is no deity except Him
entries.subject: there

spans.text: [8] AR: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ لَهُ ٱلْأَسْمَآءُ ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ EN: Allah - there is no deity except Him.
There is no deity except Me, so worship Me and establish prayer for My remembrance.

entries.description: the story of Moses reached you?
entries.subject: the story

spans.text: [9] AR: وَهَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ مُوسَىٰٓ EN: And has the story of Moses reached you?

entries.description: a fire and said to his family
entries.subject: a fire

spans.text: [10] AR: إِذْ رَءَا نَارًۭا فَقَالَ لِأَهْلِهِ ٱمْكُثُوٓا۟ إِنِّىٓ ءَانَسْتُ نَارًۭا لَّعَلِّىٓ ءَاتِيكُم مِّنْهَا بِقَبَسٍ أَوْ أَجِدُ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ هُدًۭى EN: When he saw a fire and said to his family, "Stay here; indeed, I have perceived a fire; perhaps I can bring you a torch or find at the fire some guidance."

spans.text: [17] AR: وَمَا تِلْكَ بِيَمِينِكَ يَٰمُوسَىٰ EN: And what is that in your right hand, O Moses?"

folded.subject: gentle speech
folded.object: perhaps he may be reminded or fear [Allah]

spans.text: [44] AR: فَقُولَا لَهُۥ قَوْلًۭا لَّيِّنًۭا لَّعَلَّهُۥ يَتَذَكَّرُ أَوْ يَخْشَىٰ EN: And speak to him with gentle speech that perhaps he may be reminded or fear [Allah]."
[20] AR: فَأَلْقَىٰهَا فَإِذَا هِىَ حَيَّةٌۭ تَسْعَىٰ EN: So he threw it down, and thereupon it was a snake, moving swiftly.
Indeed, I am with you both; I hear and I see.

[18] AR: قَالَ هِىَ عَصَاىَ أَتَوَكَّؤُا۟ عَلَيْهَا وَأَهُشُّ بِهَا عَلَىٰ غَنَمِى وَلِىَ فِيهَا مَـَٔارِبُ أُخْرَىٰ EN: He said, "It is my staff; I lean upon it, and I bring down leaves for my sheep and I have therein other uses."

folded.id: my sheep|and|i have therein other uses
folded.subject: my sheep

spans.text: [18] AR: قَالَ هِىَ عَصَاىَ أَتَوَكَّؤُا۟ عَلَيْهَا وَأَهُشُّ بِهَا عَلَىٰ غَنَمِى وَلِىَ فِيهَا مَـَٔارِبُ أُخْرَىٰ EN: He said, "It is my staff; I lean upon it, and I bring down leaves for my sheep and I have therein other uses."

folded.id: my signs|and|do not slacken in my remembrance
folded.subject: My signs
folded.object: do not slacken in My remembrance

spans.text: [42] AR: ٱذْهَبْ أَنتَ وَأَخُوكَ بِـَٔايَٰتِى وَلَا تَنِيَا فِى ذِكْرِى EN: Go, you and your brother, with My signs and do not slacken in My remembrance.

folded.id: our lord|is|he who gave each thing its form and then guided [it]
folded.subject: Our Lord
folded.object: He who gave each thing its form and then guided [it]

spans.text: [50] AR: قَالَ رَبُّنَا ٱلَّذِىٓ أَعْطَىٰ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ خَلْقَهُۥ ثُمَّ هَدَىٰ EN: He said, "Our Lord is He who gave each thing its form and then guided [it]."
Indeed, you are in the sacred valley of Tuwa.
[21] AR: قَالَ خُذْهَا وَلَا تَخَفْ ۖ سَنُعِيدُهَا سِيرَتَهَا ٱلْأُولَىٰ EN: [Allah] said, "Seize it and fear not; We will return it to its former condition.
[23] AR: لِنُرِيَكَ مِنْ ءَايَٰتِنَا ٱلْكُبْرَى EN: That We may show you [some] of Our greater signs.

[40] AR: إِذْ تَمْشِىٓ أُخْتُكَ فَتَقُولُ هَلْ أَدُلُّكُمْ عَلَىٰ مَن يَكْفُلُهُۥ ۖ فَرَجَعْنَٰكَ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّكَ كَىْ تَقَرَّ عَيْنُهَا وَلَا تَحْزَنَ ۚ وَقَتَلْتَ نَفْسًۭا فَنَجَّيْنَٰكَ مِنَ ٱلْغَمِّ وَفَتَنَّٰكَ فُتُونًۭا ۚ فَلَبِثْتَ سِنِينَ فِىٓ أَهْلِ مَدْيَنَ ثُمَّ جِئْتَ عَلَىٰ قَدَرٍۢ يَٰمُوسَىٰ EN: [And We favored you] when your sister went and said, 'Shall I direct you to someone who will be responsible for him?'

folded.id: so who|is|the lord of you two
folded.subject: So who

spans.text: [49] AR: قَالَ فَمَن رَّبُّكُمَا يَٰمُوسَىٰ EN: [Pharaoh] said, "So who is the Lord of you two, O Moses?"

folded.id: the chest|and|cast it into the river
folded.subject: the chest

spans.text: [39] AR: أَنِ ٱقْذِفِيهِ فِى ٱلتَّابُوتِ فَٱقْذِفِيهِ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ فَلْيُلْقِهِ ٱلْيَمُّ بِٱلسَّاحِلِ يَأْخُذْهُ عَدُوٌّۭ لِّى وَعَدُوٌّۭ لَّهُۥ ۚ وَأَلْقَيْتُ عَلَيْكَ مَحَبَّةًۭ مِّنِّى وَلِتُصْنَعَ عَلَىٰ عَيْنِىٓ EN: [Saying], 'Cast him into the chest and cast it into the river, and the river will throw it onto the bank; there will take him an enemy to Me and an enemy to him.'

folded.id: the children|of|israel and do not torment them
folded.subject: the Children
folded.object: Israel and do not torment them

spans.text: [47] AR: فَأْتِيَاهُ فَقُولَآ إِنَّا رَسُولَا رَبِّكَ فَأَرْسِلْ مَعَنَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَلَا تُعَذِّبْهُمْ ۖ قَدْ جِئْنَٰكَ بِـَٔايَةٍۢ مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۖ وَٱلسَّلَٰمُ عَلَىٰ مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَ ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ EN: So go to him and say, 'Indeed, we are messengers of your Lord, so send with us the Children of Israel and do not torment them.
[4] AR: تَنزِيلًۭا مِّمَّنْ خَلَقَ ٱلْأَرْضَ وَٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ ٱلْعُلَى EN: A revelation from He who created the earth and highest heavens,

folded.id: the hour|is|coming - i almost conceal it - so that every soul may be recompensed according to that for which it strives
folded.subject: the Hour
folded.object: coming - I almost conceal it - so that every soul may be recompensed according to that for which it strives

spans.text: [15] AR: إِنَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ ءَاتِيَةٌ أَكَادُ أُخْفِيهَا لِتُجْزَىٰ كُلُّ نَفْسٍۭ بِمَا تَسْعَىٰ EN: Indeed, the Hour is coming - I almost conceal it - so that every soul may be recompensed according to that for which it strives.
And you remained [some] years among the people of Madyan.
[2] AR: مَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِتَشْقَىٰٓ EN: We have not sent down to you the Qur'an that you be distressed
[7] AR: وَإِن تَجْهَرْ بِٱلْقَوْلِ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَعْلَمُ ٱلسِّرَّ وَأَخْفَى EN: And if you speak aloud - then indeed, He knows the secret and what is [even] more hidden.
[9] AR: وَهَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ مُوسَىٰٓ EN: And has the story of Moses reached you?
[8] AR: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ لَهُ ٱلْأَسْمَآءُ ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ EN: Allah - there is no deity except Him.
There is no deity except Me, so worship Me and establish prayer for My remembrance.
[19] AR: قَالَ أَلْقِهَا يَٰمُوسَىٰ EN: [Allah] said, "Throw it down, O Moses."

[47] AR: فَأْتِيَاهُ فَقُولَآ إِنَّا رَسُولَا رَبِّكَ فَأَرْسِلْ مَعَنَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَلَا تُعَذِّبْهُمْ ۖ قَدْ جِئْنَٰكَ بِـَٔايَةٍۢ مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۖ وَٱلسَّلَٰمُ عَلَىٰ مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَ ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ EN: So go to him and say, 'Indeed, we are messengers of your Lord, so send with us the Children of Israel and do not torment them.

[39] AR: أَنِ ٱقْذِفِيهِ فِى ٱلتَّابُوتِ فَٱقْذِفِيهِ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ فَلْيُلْقِهِ ٱلْيَمُّ بِٱلسَّاحِلِ يَأْخُذْهُ عَدُوٌّۭ لِّى وَعَدُوٌّۭ لَّهُۥ ۚ وَأَلْقَيْتُ عَلَيْكَ مَحَبَّةًۭ مِّنِّى وَلِتُصْنَعَ عَلَىٰ عَيْنِىٓ EN: [Saying], 'Cast him into the chest and cast it into the river, and the river will throw it onto the bank; there will take him an enemy to Me and an enemy to him.'

folded.id: to us|that|the punishment will be upon whoever denies and turns away
folded.subject: to us
folded.object: the punishment will be upon whoever denies and turns away

spans.text: [48] AR: إِنَّا قَدْ أُوحِىَ إِلَيْنَآ أَنَّ ٱلْعَذَابَ عَلَىٰ مَن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ EN: Indeed, it has been revealed to us that the punishment will be upon whoever denies and turns away.'
[13] AR: وَأَنَا ٱخْتَرْتُكَ فَٱسْتَمِعْ لِمَا يُوحَىٰٓ EN: And I have chosen you, so listen to what is revealed [to you].
[21] AR: قَالَ خُذْهَا وَلَا تَخَفْ ۖ سَنُعِيدُهَا سِيرَتَهَا ٱلْأُولَىٰ EN: [Allah] said, "Seize it and fear not; We will return it to its former condition.

[39] AR: أَنِ ٱقْذِفِيهِ فِى ٱلتَّابُوتِ فَٱقْذِفِيهِ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ فَلْيُلْقِهِ ٱلْيَمُّ بِٱلسَّاحِلِ يَأْخُذْهُ عَدُوٌّۭ لِّى وَعَدُوٌّۭ لَّهُۥ ۚ وَأَلْقَيْتُ عَلَيْكَ مَحَبَّةًۭ مِّنِّى وَلِتُصْنَعَ عَلَىٰ عَيْنِىٓ EN: [Saying], 'Cast him into the chest and cast it into the river, and the river will throw it onto the bank; there will take him an enemy to Me and an enemy to him.'

folded.id: worship me|and|establish prayer for my remembrance
folded.subject: worship Me

spans.text: There is no deity except Me, so worship Me and establish prayer for My remembrance.
[35] AR: إِنَّكَ كُنتَ بِنَا بَصِيرًۭا EN: Indeed, You are of us ever Seeing."

folded.id: you from|it|who does not believe in it and follows his desire
folded.subject: you from
folded.object: who does not believe in it and follows his desire

spans.text: [16] AR: فَلَا يَصُدَّنَّكَ عَنْهَا مَن لَّا يُؤْمِنُ بِهَا وَٱتَّبَعَ هَوَىٰهُ فَتَرْدَىٰ EN: So do not let one avert you from it who does not believe in it and follows his desire, for you [then] would perish.
[42] AR: ٱذْهَبْ أَنتَ وَأَخُوكَ بِـَٔايَٰتِى وَلَا تَنِيَا فِى ذِكْرِى EN: Go, you and your brother, with My signs and do not slacken in My remembrance.

folded.id: your mother|that|she might be content and not grieve
folded.subject: your mother
folded.object: she might be content and not grieve

spans.text: So We restored you to your mother that she might be content and not grieve.
